critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1123 lines — past 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/{auth,admin,trade,leaderboard,chart,marketbot}.py.

MarketBot disclaimer suffix is enforced server-side (good) — recommend a unit test asserting the marketbot.chat_with_history wrapper always appends it even on retry/error fallback paths.
